Fasteners Manufacturer in India: Bolts, Nuts, Screws, Washers & Cotter Pins

Sharma Technocast is an ISO 9001:2015 certified fasteners manufacturer in Ahmedabad, India. We make bolts, nuts, screws, washers, spring lock washers, cotter pins, lock wire and nails in all general sizes, grades and coatings to IS, DIN, ISO and ASTM standards, or to your drawing. Parts are hot forged or cold forged, with threads rolled or cut to suit the part, and every batch is checked by proof load, hardness and tensile testing. Typical manufacturing lead time is 30 to 45 days, depending on quantity, for oil & gas, construction, automotive, heavy engineering and OEM customers across India and worldwide.

Hot and Cold Forged Fasteners

We make fasteners by hot forging for large diameters and high-strength grades, and by cold forging for accurate, high-volume parts. Threads are rolled for extra fatigue strength or cut for special sizes and short runs, and every batch is checked by proof load, hardness and tensile testing before dispatch.

Global Reach & Reliable Delivery

We supply fasteners across India and for export, packed to protect threads and coatings in transit, with typical manufacturing lead times of 30 to 45 days depending on quantity.

Certified Quality Management

Sharma Technocast is ISO 9001:2015 certified. Every batch is checked for dimensions, thread fit and mechanical properties, and supplied with test reports.

Quick & Responsive Support

Send a drawing, a standard and grade, or a sample, and our team confirms feasibility, material and lead time within 24–48 hours.

Our Fastener Products

Bolts

We make hex bolts, screws and custom bolts in all general sizes and grades to IS, DIN, ISO and ASTM standards, or to your drawing. Bolts are hot or cold forged, with threads rolled or cut, for machinery, structures, equipment and OEM assemblies.

Nuts

We make hex nuts and custom nuts to match our bolts, in all general sizes and grades to standard or to drawing, so bolt and nut come from one supplier with matching thread and strength class.

Washers

We make plain washers and spring lock washers to standard sizes. Washers spread the load under the nut or bolt head, and spring lock washers keep the joint tight under vibration.

Cotter Pins & Lock Wire

We make cotter pins and lock wire to standard sizes for locking castle nuts, clevis pins and bolted joints that must not work loose. See our cotter pins range for sizes and packaging. Read our cotter pin guide →

Steel Nails

We make steel nails and nail coils in standard sizes or to your requirement, for construction, packaging and industrial use.

Ring Gaskets

We make ring-type joint (RTJ) gaskets to API 6A for wellhead equipment, pipelines and high-pressure flanged joints, where a metal-to-metal seal must hold under high pressure and temperature. See our API 6A ring gaskets.

Anchor Bolts

We make anchor bolts to IS, DIN and ASTM standards or to drawing, for fixing structures, machinery and equipment to concrete foundations.

Threaded Rods

We make threaded rods in carbon and stainless steel to standard sizes or to drawing, for structural fixing, hangers and long bolted joints, used with our nuts and washers.

Rivets

We make steel rivets to standard or drawing for permanent joints in sheet metal and structural assemblies.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a fastener?

A fastener is a part that joins two or more components mechanically, such as a bolt, nut, screw, washer, cotter pin or rivet. Threaded fasteners like bolts and screws can be removed and refitted; pins and rivets lock or join permanently.

Which fasteners does Sharma Technocast manufacture?

We make bolts, nuts, screws, washers, spring lock washers, cotter pins, lock wire, threaded rods, anchor bolts, rivets and nails, plus API 6A ring gaskets, in standard sizes or to the client's drawing.

What is the difference between a bolt and a screw?

A bolt passes through the parts and is tightened with a nut, while a screw threads into one of the parts or into a tapped hole. Bolts are usually used for heavier structural and machinery joints.

What is the difference between a bolt and a screw?

A bolt passes through the parts and is tightened with a nut, while a screw threads into one of the parts or into a tapped hole. Bolts are usually used for heavier structural and machinery joints.

Which standards do your fasteners follow?

We make fasteners to IS, DIN, ISO and ASTM standards, or to the client's drawing and specification. Ring gaskets are made to API 6A.

Which materials and coatings do you offer?

We make fasteners in all general grades of carbon steel, alloy steel and stainless steel, with coatings as per the standard or the client's requirement, chosen for strength, temperature and corrosion conditions.

How are your fasteners made?

Fasteners are hot forged or cold forged to shape, and threads are rolled or cut to suit the size, grade and quantity. Rolled threads give extra fatigue strength; cut threads suit special sizes and short runs.

How do you test fasteners?

Every batch is checked by proof load, hardness and tensile testing, along with thread and dimensional checks, and we supply material test certificates and batch test reports with the order.

Can you make custom or non-standard fasteners?

Yes. We make custom fasteners to your drawing, including special sizes, lengths, head shapes and grades, as well as standard fasteners.

What is the lead time for fasteners?

Typical manufacturing lead time is 30 to 45 days, depending on quantity, size and grade.
